questions.title: E-Commerce Order Processing Test Suite
questions.question:
Design a comprehensive testing strategy for an e-commerce order processing system.

System Components:
- Order Service: creates orders, validates inventory, calculates totals
- Payment Service: processes payments via Stripe/PayPal, handles refunds
- Inventory Service: reserves items, updates stock levels
- Notification Service: sends order confirmations, shipping updates via email/SMS
- Shipping Service: generates shipping labels, tracks packages
- Database: PostgreSQL for orders, Redis for cart sessions
- Message Queue: Kafka for async events (order.created, payment.completed)

Requirements:
- Order placement must be atomic (inventory reserved, payment processed, order created)
- Handle race conditions (multiple users buying last item)
- Retry logic for payment failures
- Idempotency for duplicate order submissions
- Transaction rollback on any step failure
- Performance: process 1000 orders/minute during peak
- Compliance: PCI DSS for payment data, GDPR for user data

Design:
1. Unit test strategy for each service (what to test, what to mock)
2. Integration test approach (database, message queue, external APIs)
3. Testing payment processing (success, failure, timeout, retry)
4. Testing race conditions and concurrency
5. Testing transaction rollback scenarios
6. Testing idempotency (duplicate requests)
7. Contract testing between services
8. End-to-end test scenarios (happy path, error paths)
9. Performance testing approach
10. Testing external API failures (Stripe, PayPal down)
11. Test data management and cleanup
12. CI/CD integration and test execution strategy
questions.realWorldScenario: Production e-commerce platform with complex order workflows and payment processing

questions.title: Banking Transaction System Testing
questions.question:
Design a testing strategy for a banking transaction system handling money transfers.

System Features:
- Account management: create accounts, check balance, account statements
- Money transfers: internal transfers (same bank), external transfers (other banks), international transfers
- Transaction processing: real-time validation, fraud detection, compliance checks
- Transaction history: audit trail, searchable history, export to PDF
- Notifications: SMS/email for large transactions, daily balance updates
- Limits: daily transfer limits, per-transaction limits, velocity checks
- Retry and compensation: automatic retry for failed transfers, compensation transactions

Critical Requirements:
- ACID transactions: money never lost or duplicated
- Strong consistency: balance always accurate
- Audit trail: every transaction logged immutably
- Idempotency: duplicate requests don't create duplicate transfers
- Security: encryption, authentication, authorization
- Compliance: regulatory reporting, KYC/AML checks
- Performance: process 10,000 transactions/second

Design:
1. Testing ACID properties and data consistency
2. Testing concurrent transfers (race conditions, deadlocks)
3. Testing transaction rollback and compensation
4. Testing idempotency mechanisms
5. Testing fraud detection integration
6. Testing compliance rules and limits
7. Testing audit logging completeness
8. Testing security (authentication, authorization, encryption)
9. Load testing for high transaction volumes
10. Chaos testing (database failures, network partitions)
11. Testing reconciliation processes
12. Compliance testing and regulatory reporting
questions.searchIntent: Testing financial system with strict correctness requirements
questions.realWorldScenario: Production banking system handling real money transfers with regulatory requirements

questions.title: Social Media Feed Testing
questions.question:
Design a testing strategy for a social media feed system (Twitter/Facebook-like).

System Components:
- Post Service: create posts, edit posts, delete posts
- Feed Service: generate personalized feeds, ranking algorithm
- Engagement Service: likes, comments, shares, retweets
- Notification Service: real-time notifications for interactions
- Search Service: full-text search, trending topics
- Media Service: image/video upload, processing, CDN delivery
- Cache Layer: Redis for feed caching, user sessions
- Message Queue: Kafka for fan-out, real-time updates

Key Features:
- Real-time feed updates (new posts appear within 2 seconds)
- Personalized ranking (ML-based, considers engagement, recency)
- Pagination and infinite scroll
- Privacy controls (public, friends-only, private)
- Content moderation (spam detection, inappropriate content)
- Scale: 100M users, 1B posts, 10M concurrent users

Design:
1. Testing feed generation and personalization
2. Testing real-time updates and notifications
3. Testing pagination and cursor-based loading
4. Testing privacy controls and access restrictions
5. Testing engagement features (likes, comments, shares)
6. Testing cache consistency and invalidation
7. Testing content moderation integration
8. Testing media upload and processing
9. Load testing for high concurrent users
10. Testing eventual consistency scenarios
11. Testing fan-out performance (celebrity posts)
12. A/B testing framework for ranking algorithms
questions.searchIntent: Testing social media platform with real-time features
questions.realWorldScenario: Production social media platform with personalized feeds and real-time updates

questions.title: Ride-Sharing Platform Testing
questions.question:
Design a testing strategy for a ride-sharing platform (Uber/Lyft-like).

System Components:
- Location Service: track driver locations (2-second updates), geospatial queries
- Matching Service: match riders with nearby drivers, ETA calculation
- Pricing Service: surge pricing, dynamic pricing, promo codes
- Trip Service: start trip, end trip, calculate fare
- Payment Service: charge riders, pay drivers, handle splits
- Notification Service: push notifications for ride status
- Rating Service: rate drivers/riders, maintain reputation scores
- Real-time Tracking: WebSocket for live location updates

Key Requirements:
- Driver matching within 5 seconds
- Accurate ETA calculations
- Handle network disruptions gracefully
- Prevent duplicate ride matching
- Handle driver cancellations and reassignment
- Surge pricing accuracy during high demand
- Offline capability for drivers
- Safety features (emergency button, trip sharing)

Design:
1. Testing geospatial queries and driver matching
2. Testing real-time location updates and tracking
3. Testing ETA calculation accuracy
4. Testing surge pricing algorithms
5. Testing race conditions (multiple drivers accepting)
6. Testing network disruptions and offline modes
7. Testing trip lifecycle (start, pause, end)
8. Testing payment splitting and promo codes
9. Load testing for peak demand
10. Testing safety features integration
11. Testing driver app and rider app synchronization
12. End-to-end testing across mobile and backend
questions.realWorldScenario: Production ride-sharing platform with real-time matching and location tracking

questions.title: Video Streaming Platform Testing
questions.question:
Design a testing strategy for a video streaming platform (Netflix/YouTube-like).

System Components:
- Video Ingestion: upload, transcoding, quality variants (4K, 1080p, 720p)
- CDN Integration: video distribution, edge caching, geo-routing
- Playback Service: adaptive bitrate streaming, resume playback
- Recommendation Service: ML-based recommendations, personalization
- Search Service: video search, filtering, sorting
- User Service: profiles, watch history, preferences
- Subscription Service: billing, payment processing, plan management
- Analytics Service: watch time, engagement, quality metrics

Key Features:
- Adaptive bitrate streaming (switch quality based on bandwidth)
- Instant video start (<2 seconds)
- Resume playback across devices
- Offline downloads
- Live streaming support
- Concurrent streams per account
- DRM content protection
- Multi-language subtitles and audio tracks

Design:
1. Testing video upload and transcoding pipeline
2. Testing adaptive bitrate switching
3. Testing playback across devices and browsers
4. Testing CDN integration and edge caching
5. Testing resume playback synchronization
6. Testing concurrent stream limits
7. Testing DRM and content protection
8. Testing recommendation accuracy
9. Load testing for concurrent viewers
10. Testing live streaming latency
11. Testing offline download and playback
12. Testing analytics data accuracy

questions.title: Healthcare Appointment System Testing
questions.question:
Design a testing strategy for a healthcare appointment scheduling system.

System Components:
- Appointment Service: book, reschedule, cancel appointments
- Provider Service: manage doctor schedules, availability, specialties
- Patient Service: patient records, medical history, insurance
- Notification Service: reminders (24hr, 1hr before), cancellations
- Telemedicine Service: video consultations, screen sharing
- Prescription Service: e-prescriptions, pharmacy integration
- Billing Service: insurance claims, co-pay processing
- EHR Integration: sync with electronic health records

Compliance Requirements:
- HIPAA compliance: data encryption, access controls, audit logs
- Patient privacy: consent management, data anonymization
- Regulatory: state medical board requirements, insurance regulations
- Security: multi-factor authentication, role-based access

Key Features:
- Double-booking prevention
- Wait list management
- Emergency slot allocation
- Multi-location support
- Insurance eligibility verification
- Integration with external systems (pharmacies, labs)

Design:
1. Testing appointment scheduling and conflict prevention
2. Testing HIPAA compliance (encryption, access controls)
3. Testing patient privacy and consent management
4. Testing telemedicine video quality and stability
5. Testing integration with EHR systems
6. Testing insurance verification and billing
7. Testing notification delivery reliability
8. Testing audit logging completeness
9. Security testing (authentication, authorization)
10. Testing fail-over and disaster recovery
11. Testing data anonymization for reporting
12. Compliance testing and regulatory requirements

questions.title: Real-Time Chat Application Testing
questions.question:
Design a testing strategy for a real-time chat application (Slack/WhatsApp-like).

System Components:
- Messaging Service: send messages, edit, delete, reactions
- Presence Service: online/offline status, typing indicators
- WebSocket Gateway: real-time message delivery
- Channel Service: create channels, manage members, permissions
- Search Service: message search, full-text indexing
- File Service: file uploads, image preview, virus scanning
- Notification Service: push notifications, email digests
- Voice/Video Service: WebRTC for calls, screen sharing

Key Features:
- Message delivery guarantees (at-least-once, exactly-once)
- Message ordering across distributed system
- Offline message sync when coming online
- End-to-end encryption for direct messages
- Thread conversations
- Message reactions and polls
- @mentions and notifications
- Read receipts and delivery status
- File sharing with preview

Design:
1. Testing message delivery and ordering
2. Testing WebSocket connection handling
3. Testing presence and typing indicators
4. Testing offline message synchronization
5. Testing end-to-end encryption
6. Testing file upload and virus scanning
7. Testing voice/video call quality
8. Testing notification delivery
9. Load testing for high concurrent connections
10. Testing network disruptions and reconnection
11. Testing message search accuracy
12. Cross-platform testing (web, mobile, desktop)
questions.realWorldScenario: Production chat platform with real-time messaging and file sharing

questions.title: Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform Testing
questions.question:
Design a testing strategy for a multi-tenant SaaS CRM platform.

System Architecture:
- Tenant Isolation: separate schemas per tenant, data isolation
- User Management: SSO, SAML, OAuth, role-based access
- Customization: custom fields, workflows, business rules per tenant
- API Layer: REST API with rate limiting per tenant
- Billing Service: usage-based billing, subscription management
- Analytics Service: tenant-specific dashboards, reporting
- Background Jobs: scheduled jobs, data exports, backups
- Integration Hub: Zapier, webhooks, custom integrations

Key Requirements:
- Complete data isolation between tenants
- Tenant-specific customizations don't affect others
- Performance isolation (one tenant can't impact others)
- Fair resource allocation and rate limiting
- Zero-downtime deployments
- Tenant onboarding and offboarding
- Data migration and export
- Compliance: SOC2, GDPR, data residency

Design:
1. Testing tenant data isolation and security
2. Testing tenant-specific customizations
3. Testing performance isolation
4. Testing rate limiting per tenant
5. Testing user authentication (SSO, SAML)
6. Testing role-based access control
7. Testing billing and usage tracking
8. Testing tenant onboarding/offboarding
9. Testing data migration and export
10. Load testing with multiple tenants
11. Testing background job isolation
12. Compliance testing (SOC2, GDPR)
questions.searchIntent: Testing multi-tenant SaaS with isolation requirements
questions.realWorldScenario: Production SaaS platform with multiple tenants and strict isolation
